text: [88] yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu akkosakaparibhāsako ariyupavādī sabrahmacārīnaṃ aṭṭhānametaṃ anavakāso 1 yaṃ so dasannaṃ byasanānaṃ aññataraññataraṃ byasanaṃ na nigaccheyya 2 katamesaṃ dasannaṃ anadhigataṃ nādhigacchati adhigatā parihāyati saddhammassa na vodāyanti saddhammesu vā adhimāniko hoti anabhirato vā brahmacariyaṃ carati aññataraṃ vā saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati gāḷhaṃ vā rogātakaṃ phusati ummādaṃ vā pāpuṇāti cittakkhepaṃ sammūḷoha kālaṃ karoti kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu akkosakaparibhāsako ariyupavādī sabrahmacārīnaṃ aṭṭhānametaṃ anavakāso 1 yaṃ so imesaṃ dasannaṃ byasanānaṃ aññataraññataraṃ byasanaṃ na nigaccheyyāti 2 .
